UPDATE forge_jobs
                SET
                    status = 'pending',
                    worker_id = NULL,
                    claimed_at = NULL,
                    started_at = NULL,
                    last_error = $2,
                    scheduled_at = NOW() + make_interval(secs => $3),
                    cancel_requested_at = NULL,
                    cancelled_at = NULL,
                    cancel_reason = NULL
                WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'running'
